translation result

  • CURIE: gmeow:translationResult
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/translationResult
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence

The lexical form(s) produced by a translation. Non-functional: competing translations of the same inscription coexist without privilege (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:InscriptionTranslation -> gmeow:InformationObject Sub-property of: gmeow:observationResult

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:translationResult from gmeow:InscriptionTranslation to gmeow:InformationObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observationResult, gmeow:InscriptionTranslation, gmeow:InformationObject
